text:
Ana (CEO): thanks everyone who tuned into the all-hands. quick follow-up: a few questions about the hiring plan and the nodal team changes — leaving this thread open for clarifying Qs.

Raj (VP Eng): happy to answer. short TL;DR: we’re shifting from function-based squads to three nodal pillars (Serving, Platform, Product infra). headcount moves are primarily internal reallocations + some new roles for Dedicated/Private.

Marta (Eng TL): can you clarify whether oncall rotations move with people or stay per-squad? we can't split escalation paths mid-quarter.

Raj (VP Eng): good q. oncall follows the node, not the person. if you move teams in the reorg window we aim for a one-pay period overlap to shadow handoff. no forced immediate swaps.

Lena (People Ops): hiring cadence: external hiring will prioritize 40% backend infra, 30% ML infra, 30% product/console. timeline is Q2 hires ramping, priority roles posted next week.

Sean (Platform): will current Dedicated capacity engineers be moved into Serving node? I saw a note about 'routing policies team' being created.

Raj (VP Eng): yes, Dedicated folks mostly fold into Serving. routing policies is a small cross-node feature team — will have engineers from Serving + Platform for first 90 days.

Lisa (Sales): from customer-facing side: will SLAs/support model change with the reorg? customers ask about single point of contact.

Lena (People Ops): customer success org unaffected; sales/CS will keep regional AEs. support handovers will be documented in the playbook we link here next week.

Marta (Eng TL): can we get the headcount delta numbers? a table would help teams plan backfills.

Raj (VP Eng): sure — high level numbers (planned vs current) below:

```
Current FTEs by node:
- Serving: 48
- Platform: 36
- Product Infra: 28

Planned Q3 target:
- Serving: 60 (+12)
- Platform: 44 (+8)
- Product Infra: 32 (+4)
```

Raj (VP Eng): internal transfers expected to cover ~60% of that growth; external hiring budget approved for the remaining 40%.

Sean (Platform): re: career ladders — will IC leveling change if you join a node cross-functional team?

Ana (CEO): leveling remains the same; role descriptions will include node-specific competencies. we won't reset levels for people making a lateral move.

Marta (Eng TL): request: please publish a clear timeline for interviews and handoffs. PMs are worried about roadmap continuity.

Lena (People Ops): timeline plan: job posts live by 2026-04-01, internal mobility window open until 2026-04-15, offers starting mid-April, and rolling handoffs through May. detailed calendar in Confluence later today.

Lisa (Sales): flagged — any change to priority hiring for enterprise integrations team? our largest customers asked for dedicated bandwidth.

Raj (VP Eng): integrations stay high priority. we have a small dedicated lane inside Product Infra for enterprise integrations; hiring there is part of the Product Infra delta above.

Marta (Eng TL): last: will we have a grace period for oncall SLAs while new teams stabilize?

Raj (VP Eng): yes — two-week reduced-burn window post-handoff, with SRE on standby. deploy-bot: posting incident coverage rota for transition weeks.

deploy-bot: scheduled message: "rota publish: 2026-05-01 to 2026-05-15 — SRE standby + reduced oncall load" :bell:

Ana (CEO): thanks all. if anyone has follow-ups that are 1:1 or sensitive, DM Lena or Raj. otherwise we'll update the Confluence playbook and share the calendar link here when available. :sparkles:

Marta (Eng TL): thanks — very helpful.

Sean (Platform): noted, will coordinate routing test plan with Serving leads.

Lisa (Sales): appreciate the clarity, will sync with CS leads.

Lena (People Ops): putting the mobility form in #people-ops and will ping managers to review transfer requests within 3 business days.

Ana (CEO): closing thread for day but we'll leave edits open. please keep Qs coming.
